The '''Tothis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tothis]].
